description: This file defines the OnyxGuardrail class, a custom guardrail implementation for integrating with Onyx security guard server within a larger LLM framework. It handles environment configuration, validation requests to an external API, and applies guardrails based on responses.

classes.name: OnyxGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class that communicates with the Onyx security server to validate requests and responses, raising HTTP exceptions when violations are detected.

methods.name: __init__( self, api_base: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs )
methods.description: Initializes the OnyxGuardrail with optional API base URL and API key, fetching environment variables as defaults.

methods.name: dict _validate_with_guard_server( self, payload: Any, input_type: Literal["request", "response"], conversation_id: str, )
methods.description: Sends validation request to the external Onyx guard server, and raises HTTPException if the payload violates security rules.

methods.name: GenericGuardrailAPIInputs apply_guardrail( self, inputs: GenericGuardrailAPIInputs, request_data: dict, input_type: Literal["request", "response"], logging_obj: Optional["LiteLLMLoggingObj"] = None, )
methods.description: Applies the guardrail logic by preparing payloads based on input data, calling validation, and handling errors.

methods.name: Optional[Type["GuardrailConfigModel"]] get_config_model()
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for this guardrail, importing OnyxGuardrailConfigModel dynamically.
